name: What factors affect the complexity of a roof leak assessment?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the complexity of a roof leak assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors can increase the complexity of a roof leak assessment. These include the age of the roof, the type of roofing material (e.g., slate, tile, metal vs. asphalt shingles), multiple layers of roofing, difficult-to-access areas like steep pitches or crowded rooflines, and previous repair attempts that may have obscured the original issue. Each of these elements requires a more detailed and time-consuming inspection to accurately identify the leak source, which can impact the overall assessment process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Factors affecting complexity include roof age, material type, multiple layers, difficult access, and previous repairs.
